name: extract_repo_ast
description: Scans repository files and extracts whole-codebase AST including exports, imports, functions, classes, types, and entry points into normalized JSON. Supports Go, Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript via Tree-Sitter and native AST modules.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the repository root directory.

languages.description: Languages to parse. Defaults to auto-detect from file extensions if omitted.

include_patterns.description: Glob patterns for files to include (e.g., ['src/**/*.ts', 'pkg/**/*.go']).

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude (e.g., ['node_modules/**', 'vendor/**']).

returns.description: Normalized AST graph containing all symbols, their types, import/export edges, and call relationships.

name: detect_dynamic_invocations
description: Scans AST for dynamic reflection, dynamic module imports, runtime eval, string-based function dispatch, event emitter registrations, and environment-conditional code paths. Returns flagged patterns with file locations and confidence scores.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to scan.

symbol_id.description: Optional. Qualified symbol name to scope the scan to a specific function or class.

patterns.description: Specific dynamic patterns to scan for. Defaults to all if omitted.
